courses.title: ChatGPT for Professional Work
courses.shortDescription: Live online training in chatgpt for professional work for women who want practical, home-friendly skills.
courses.description: LIVE ONLINE TRAINING – NOT A RECORDED COURSE. This one-month Zoom programme focuses on AI tools, data handling and productivity automation. You will attend four live classes each week, complete practical exercises and take part in question-and-answer sessions with the instructor. Speeds up everyday work with AI assistants, spreadsheets and basic data tasks for remote or office roles. Intakes are planned for the 1st of every month. Exact class days and timings are shared with registered participants after enrolment. Classes are interactive; this is not a pre-recorded video course.
courses.schedule: Four live classes per week. Exact class days and timings will be shared with registered participants.
learningOutcomes: Write effective prompts for common work tasks
Use AI tools to draft and refine content
Organise data in spreadsheets
Automate simple repetitive steps with no-code tools
requirements: Smartphone or computer with a stable internet connection
Willingness to attend scheduled live Zoom sessions
Notebook or digital document for exercises and notes
Free accounts for selected AI or spreadsheet tools as guided in class
